name: Channelled Force
summary: When a Grey Knights unit fights, it can pass a Leadership test to give its Psychic melee weapons Sustained Hits 1 or Lethal Hits until the end of the phase.

name: Fury of Titan
summary: A unit set up via Deep Strike re-rolls a Hit roll of 1 and a Wound roll of 1 on its attacks for the rest of the turn.

name: Hallowed Ground
summary: Your deployment zone, area near Purifier Squads, and (conditionally) No Man's Land or the enemy zone count as Hallowed Ground. Grey Knights re-roll a Hit roll of 1 each attack; Purifiers or units wholly inside re-roll the Hit roll instead.
